primary_task: Act as router for Expo/EAS tasks: classify the user's goal, load the matching expo-*/eas-* leaf skill, and apply shared setup rules.

requirements.name: Read
requirements.evidence: load that leaf's SKILL.md and follow it; read the expo version in package.json

requirements.name: node/npx
requirements.evidence: Starting a new Expo app? ... npx create-expo-app@latest; Install packages with npx expo install

requirements.name: docs.expo.dev
requirements.evidence: Read the docs for that SDK, not latest (version-pinned docs.expo.dev URL)

requirements.name: eas
requirements.evidence: EAS auth & linking (only needed for build/submit/update/observe/workflows): eas whoami
requirements.check: command -v eas; npm view eas-cli (registry reachable)

notes: The router's own work is reading/classifying; leaf expo-*/eas-* skills it routes to are not installed in this session (~/.claude/skills has only session-start-hook) - not a rubric kind, but the downstream work would lack them. docs.expo.dev is blocked; treated as non-hard advisory rule (only before version-specific advice). Setup rules are conditional on the task.
